zh: 你是不是也一直觉得，自媒体是那种有团队、
en: Do you also think self-media is only for people with a team?

zh: 口才好、敢出镜的人，才能干的事？
en: Only for people who speak well and dare to be on camera?

zh: 我今天必须给你说一句很扎心的话：
en: I need to tell you something blunt today.

zh: 真正缺的根本不是设备，也不是露脸的勇气。
en: What you lack is not equipment or the courage to show your face.

zh: 而是到现在都没看明白，
en: You still may not understand

zh: 平台到底为什么样的内容买单。
en: what kind of content platforms actually pay for.

zh: 我们直接看一个最硬核的例子。
en: Let us start with the clearest example.

zh: YouTube为什么能成长为全球最大的视频平台之一？
en: Why did YouTube become one of the world’s largest video platforms?

zh: 不是因为它自己生产了所有视频，
en: It is not because YouTube produced every video itself.

zh: 而是因为它搭建了一个闭环。
en: It built a reinforcing loop.

zh: 创作者持续生产内容，用户停留更久，
en: Creators keep publishing and users stay longer.

zh: 商家愿意投广告，平台拿到广告和订阅收入之后，
en: Advertisers spend, and the platform earns ad and subscription revenue.

zh: 再把一部分收益分给创作者。
en: Then part of that revenue is shared with creators.

zh: 这个循环一旦转起来，优秀创作者就愿意留下来，
en: Once the loop works, strong creators stay.

zh: 用户也愿意继续看，商家也愿意继续投。
en: Users keep watching, and advertisers keep spending.

zh: YouTube官方披露过，过去四年，
en: YouTube has stated that over the past four years,

zh: 给创作者、艺术家和媒体公司支付超过1000亿美元。
en: it paid creators, artists, and media companies over 100 billion dollars.

zh: Alphabet 2025年财报里也提到，
en: Alphabet’s 2025 results also stated that

zh: YouTube广告和订阅年收入超过600亿美元。
en: YouTube annual ad and subscription revenue exceeded 60 billion dollars.

zh: 这说明平台愿意为优质的注意力付钱。
en: Platforms are willing to pay for valuable attention.

zh: 回到抖音，其实逻辑也类似，只是形式不一样。
en: Douyin follows a similar logic, though the formats differ.

zh: 你能看到创作者伙伴计划、中视频相关收益、
en: There are creator programs and mid-length video revenue.

zh: 星图商单、全民任务、商品橱窗、
en: There are Xingtu deals, platform tasks, and product showcases.

zh: 精选联盟、直播带货。
en: There are affiliate programs and livestream commerce.

zh: 这些不是让普通人躺着赚钱的按钮，
en: These are not buttons for effortless income.

zh: 而是平台告诉你一件事：
en: They reveal one thing about the platform.

zh: 只要你能持续生产有价值的内容，
en: If you can consistently make valuable content,

zh: 平台、品牌、商家和用户之间，
en: the platform, brands, merchants, and users

zh: 就存在一套可以分配收益的机制。
en: can participate in a mechanism that distributes revenue.

zh: 那么问题来了，过去普通人为什么很难做？
en: So why was this so difficult for ordinary people?

zh: 因为内容生产太贵了。
en: Because content production was too costly.

zh: 你要选题、查资料、写文案、拍摄、剪辑、
en: You need topics, research, copy, filming, and editing.

zh: 做封面、复盘数据等等。
en: You also need covers and data reviews.

zh: 任何一个环节卡住，你就会停下来。
en: If any stage gets stuck, production stops.

zh: 很多人不是不想做自媒体，
en: Many people do want to create content.

zh: 是一想到要露脸、要表达、要剪辑、要坚持，
en: But showing up, speaking, editing, and persisting feel overwhelming.

zh: 就已经放弃了。
en: So they give up before starting.

zh: 但AI出来以后，这个门槛正在被压低。
en: AI is now lowering this barrier.

zh: 你不会写文案，AI可以帮你整理逻辑。
en: AI can help structure your copy and reasoning.

zh: 你不会找选题，AI可以帮你拆热点和同行。
en: AI can analyze trends and peer accounts for topics.

zh: 你不会做脚本，AI可以把你的想法先变成提纲。
en: AI can turn your ideas into a script outline.

zh: 你不想一开始出镜，可以先做图文、录屏、
en: If you do not want to appear at first, start with posts or screen recordings.

zh: 口播字幕、知识卡片。
en: You can also make narrated captions or knowledge cards.

zh: 你不会复盘，AI可以帮你看评论、看数据，
en: AI can help review comments and performance data.

zh: 找下一条怎么改。
en: Then it can suggest what to improve next.

zh: 这就是我之前一直说的，
en: This is what I have been saying:

zh: AI背后站着的是一整套文明级的认知能力。
en: AI is backed by accumulated, civilization-scale knowledge.

zh: 但这里一定要说清楚：
en: But one point must be clear.

zh: AI不是替你赚钱，AI是替你降低试错成本。
en: AI does not earn for you. It lowers the cost of experimentation.

zh: 真正要你做的是，把一个问题讲清楚，
en: Your job is to explain one problem clearly,

zh: 把一个经验讲明白，把一个工具用给别人看，
en: make one experience understandable, and show a tool in use,

zh: 把这个过程持续地记录下来。
en: then keep documenting the process.

zh: 普通人今天最现实的路径，不是辞职All in，
en: The realistic path is not quitting your job and going all in.

zh: 也不是一上来就买课、囤工具、搞矩阵。
en: Nor is it buying courses, hoarding tools, or building account matrices.

zh: 更现实的是，先用AI跑一个30条内容的小闭环。
en: A better start is a 30-post experiment powered by AI.

zh: 第一步，选一个你能长期观察的人群。
en: Step one: choose a group you can observe for the long term.

zh: 比如本地老板、设计师、宝妈、职场新人、
en: For example, local owners, designers, mothers, or new professionals.

zh: 个体户、AI小白等等。
en: It could also be sole traders or AI beginners.

zh: 第二步，只解决他们的一个具体问题。
en: Step two: solve one specific problem for them.

zh: 不要一上来就讲什么“AI改变世界”，
en: Do not begin with a vague claim that AI will change the world.

zh: 而是讲“不会写文案怎么办”，
en: Explain what to do when someone cannot write copy.

zh: “不敢出镜怎么做账号”，
en: Explain how to build an account without appearing on camera.

zh: “一个人怎么低成本地开始记录”。
en: Explain how one person can start documenting at low cost.

zh: 第三步，就是用AI把内容的成本降下来。
en: Step three: use AI to reduce production cost.

zh: 每天产出一个选题、一个脚本、
en: Produce one topic and one script each day.

zh: 一张封面的思路和一个发布复盘。
en: Add one cover concept and one post review.

zh: 第四步，看真实的反馈。
en: Step four: inspect real feedback.

zh: 有没有人看完？有没有人收藏？
en: Did anyone finish watching or save it?

zh: 有没有人评论说“这个我用得上”？
en: Did anyone comment that it was useful?

zh: 有没有人私信问下一步？
en: Did anyone message you to ask what comes next?

zh: 如果这四步跑不通，别着急谈变现。
en: If these four steps fail, do not rush to monetization.

zh: 因为平台不是奖励你的努力，
en: The platform does not reward effort by itself.

zh: 平台奖励的是用户愿意停留的内容。
en: It rewards content that users choose to stay with.

zh: 但你只要持续跑，哪怕没赚到钱，
en: Keep running the experiment, even before it earns money.

zh: 你也已经在积累一个非常重要的东西：数字资产。
en: You are still building something important: a digital asset.

zh: 你的每一条内容，都是一次公开表达。
en: Every post is a public expression of your thinking.

zh: 你的每一次复盘，都是一次市场反馈。
en: Every review is a piece of market feedback.

zh: 你的每一个案例、观点、方法、失败记录，
en: Every case, viewpoint, method, and failure record

zh: 都会变成别人判断你的材料。
en: becomes evidence others can use to assess you.

zh: 这比你把想法藏进脑子里，强得太多了。
en: That is far better than keeping every idea in your head.

zh: 因为没人知道你会什么，机会就不会来找你。
en: If nobody knows what you can do, opportunities cannot find you.

zh: 你不发布、不测试、不接受反馈，
en: If you never publish, test, or accept feedback,

zh: 你永远不知道自己的判断到底对不对。
en: you will never know whether your judgment is right.

zh: 所以作为普通人，我给大家的建议很简单：
en: So my advice to ordinary people is simple.

zh: 不要先问AI能不能让你赚钱。
en: Do not first ask whether AI can make you money.

zh: 我们先问三个问题。
en: Ask these three questions first.

zh: 你能不能用AI，把一个具体的问题讲清楚？
en: Can you use AI to explain one specific problem clearly?

zh: 你能不能用最低的成本，连续发30条内容？
en: Can you publish 30 posts continuously at minimal cost?

zh: 我能不能把这些内容，变成别人看得到、
en: Can I turn this content into something people can see,

zh: 能判断、能信任我的数字资产？
en: evaluate, and use to decide whether to trust me?

zh: 这条路不保证你一定变现，
en: This path does not guarantee monetization.

zh: 也不保证平台一定给你流量。
en: It does not guarantee platform traffic either.

zh: 但是对于一个没有团队、没有资本、
en: But for someone without a team or capital,

zh: 没有现成资源的普通人来说，
en: and without ready-made resources,

zh: AI加自媒体，可能是目前最值得尝试的
en: AI plus self-media may be one of today’s most worthwhile

zh: 低成本路径之一。
en: low-cost paths to test.

zh: 因为它花掉的不是你的全部身家，
en: It does not require risking everything you own.

zh: 而是你的认知、时间和持续的反馈能力。
en: It asks for your thinking, time, and ability to keep learning from feedback.

zh: 你不需要一开始就成为一个大博主。
en: You do not need to begin as a major creator.

zh: 你先成为一个被看见的人。
en: First, become someone who can be seen.

zh: 我从7月8号开始做这个口播视频到现在，
en: I started making these talking-head videos on July 8.

zh: 其实也就刚好一个月。
en: It has now been exactly one month.

zh: 在这个过程当中，我是在不断地去验证，
en: Throughout this process, I have kept testing

zh: AI通过所有的这些赋能，到底能带来什么。
en: what AI-enabled support can actually bring me.

zh: 其实在这个短期当中，我也收获很多。
en: Even in this short period, I have gained a lot.

zh: 也加到了很多的一些粉丝，
en: I have also connected with a number of followers,

zh: 包括兰州本地的一些创业者。
en: including entrepreneurs here in Lanzhou.

zh: 我觉得这就是一个收获。
en: I see that as a real gain already.

zh: 至于它未来如何去变现、能不能变现，
en: As for how or whether it will monetize in the future,

zh: 我长期去做这样的一个数字资产的积累，
en: I will keep accumulating this kind of digital asset.

zh: 我相信它一定是有价值的。
en: I believe that long-term accumulation has value.

zh: 所以作为普通人来说，我们第一步真的一定要开始。
en: For ordinary people, the first real step is simply to begin.

zh: 一定要开始。
en: You must begin.

zh: 我是超哥，我在兰州AI创业。
en: I am Chao, building an AI venture in Lanzhou.
